test_title: PYST 51: SSC CPO - English Comprehension (Held on 03 Oct, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
In the following sentence, four words are underlined, out of which one word is incorrectly spelt. Identify the INCORRECTLY spelt word.

Traffic accidents are increasing steadily, and large cities are __plaged__ by traffic __congestion__. Worst of all is the air pollution caused by internal __combustion__ engine, __uninterruptedly__.
solution:
The correct answer is Option 1. i.e. **plaged.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The incorrect word is "**plaged**." The correct spelling is "**plagued**."
 
• Plague
